summary: New read-only scripts/evidence-skip-report: for the pull request runs of the last 24 hours (or --hours), per check, how many skipped and why the others ran (lane edit, merge tree, not signed, failed, protected file, sampled, shadow, other), with the not-signed pull requests listed by branch and, from pre-push receipts, by the seat that pushed them.

replay.detail: A read-only report script; no graph, claim or storage change.

rules.detail: No skip policy, gate or verifier change.
